question: Can the existing run-owned native Doc and Sheet in the owned Shared Drive export PDF and OpenDocument representations through the current Drive grant without enabling another API?
kind: Pre-registered GET-only live protocol probe; no Cirrove package behavior changes in this measurement.
source_items: The exact Doc and Sheet created in the dedicated Cirrove Validation folder for google-native-import-live.json; no other Workspace item is addressed.
official_contract: Google lists PDF and OpenDocument exports for native Docs and Sheets at https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/guides/ref-export-formats.
arms: A: verify exact item ID, native MIME, parent, selected Shared Drive and current version before any export
B: request PDF and ODT from the Doc and PDF and ODS from the Sheet; require HTTP 200, bounded bytes, valid PDF or OpenDocument package and the known run marker in the representation
C: read the exact metadata again and require unchanged versions and scope, proving the probe was read-only
endpoint: Each of the four bounded exports must have a valid format signature and expected marker; exact source versions must remain unchanged. Any failure is recorded per format and cannot be used as an implementation claim.
prediction: The tiny run-owned fixtures should export in all four Google-listed formats under the existing Drive API grant; PDF text extraction or ODF XML may reveal conversion limits even when the request succeeds.
limits: Two tiny fixtures cannot establish formatting, formulas, charts, accessibility, multi-sheet fidelity or exports near Google's size cap.
temporary_filesystem: btrfs under /home; private TMPDIR and SQLITE_TMPDIR were not tmpfs

result.scope: Both exact IDs, run-owned names, native MIME types, parent folder, selected Shared Drive and current versions matched before and after all requests.
result.doc_pdf: HTTP 200; 19,330 bytes; pdfinfo accepted the PDF, pdftotext found the exact run marker.
result.doc_odt: HTTP 200; 3,108,613 bytes; the ZIP package had the OpenDocument text MIME and intact entries, and content.xml contained the marker.
result.sheet_pdf: HTTP 200; 21,731 bytes; pdfinfo accepted the PDF, pdftotext found the exact run marker.
result.sheet_ods: HTTP 200; 9,031 bytes; the ZIP package had the OpenDocument spreadsheet MIME and intact entries, and content.xml contained the marker.
result.versions: The exact Doc and Sheet metadata versions were unchanged after the four GET-only exports.
result.interpretation: These four formats work for the tiny run-owned fixtures through the existing Drive API grant. Cirrove currently exposes only DOCX/XLSX in its native read-only packages; this probe does not add PDF or OpenDocument files to the mount.
